about: Canada's regional 'Avoid all travel' blocks the stay spots were checked against (Global Affairs Canada's feed of 2026-10-15, then its live feed on 2026-10-18, again on 2026-10-30: Ethiopia's border band now takes in Eritrea, Saudi Arabia's Asir, Jazan and Najran block lost a doubled 'to', and its Riyadh airport block became one naming Dammam's airport too; no place moved in or out): per country, each block by its heading, a fingerprint of its words, and the places inside it that never become stay anchors. Under 'us', the same for the US State Department's regional 'Do not travel' areas where it names them (its RSS feed of 2026-10-18): per country below level 4, a fingerprint of the feed's 'Do Not Travel to' words and the places inside an area they name. Where the feed says some areas have increased risk but names none (Mexico, India), the whole row is fingerprinted and its 'note' records the review by hand against travel.state.gov. A skipped place may carry its point ('ll') and other names ('aka'); a candidate within 5 km of that point, or under one of those names, is skipped too. Under 'marks', the guide places inside a block that carry an ⓘ with Canada's words for it (fxtracker/avoid_marks.py). scripts/gen_stay_spots.py --check flags a block or a US list that is new, gone or reworded, and a mark whose block is.

BJ.note: Reviewed keep (Doug, 2026-10-19): "areas of Benin bordering Burkina Faso" and "the border region in northern or northeastern Benin" name no distance, so they are reviewed by hand, not a skip. Tanougou Falls (Tanguiéta, Atacora) is 40–50 km from Burkina Faso, outside Canada's 50 km avoid-all band (the 2026-10-17 audit's sampling) and in Canada's avoid-non-essential Atacora; Pendjari, which Canada names, stays skipped under Canada's block.

BR.note: Reviewed keep (Doug, 2026-10-19): the public line "Do Not Travel to : International land borders" names no distance, so it is reviewed by hand, not a skip. Iguazú Falls stays: the feed's only Foz rule is the staff one ("Within 100 miles/160 km of Brazil’s land borders (except travel to the Foz do Iguacu and Pantanal)"), and Canada's 20 km Paraguay band is avoid non-essential. Rio, Salvador and Manaus are hundreds of km from any land border.

marks.about: The guide places inside one of the blocks above that carry an ⓘ with Canada's own words for it (fxtracker/avoid_marks.py, public/avoid-marks.json, generated from here). Per place: its surface ('activity' or 'seasonal') and item (the activity's label or the season row's 'what', as activities.json has them), the place it names and where it falls, its class in the 2026-10 audit (A inside, A~ partly inside; the thin-margin A* rows such as Nigeria's Zuma Rock are Doug's call and never marked here), the block's heading and the fingerprint of the block it was checked against (the block's own fp above), Canada's words verbatim (' … ' where words are left out; the bullets are Canada's) and the day they were checked against the live feed. Doug, 2026-10-30: avoid-all blocks only; none in the 22 guides Canada says to avoid entirely; Ethiopia, Chad, Cameroon and Tajikistan keep their places, marked. Summary lines carry no marker: each one's place is an activity marked in the same list, and Chad's and Pakistan's already say to check advisories.
